$comment: Tags the AI may suggest. Edit freely: `tag` is what gets saved on a design (lowercase, dashes, max 30 characters), `label` is shown in the admin panel, `text` describes the look to the CLIP model. Single-choice groups suggest at most one tag; multi-choice groups compare each tag against `negative` and suggest at most `max_tags` (default 3). `min_score` (0-1) is how sure the model must be before a tag is suggested. Restart the AI service after editing.
